task.description:
WF-03 Step Final: git-merge for GH-533 / ISS-0209.

Branch: feature/WF03-GH533-20260807 (already contains 3 commits since main)

Tasks per docs/agents/protocols/GIT_MERGE.md:
1. git fetch origin main
2. git rebase origin/main (resolve conflicts if any)
3. gh pr create --base main --title "fix(test-auth): remove destructive tenant_default DROP SCHEMA recovery (ISS-0209/GH-533)" --body (use body from PR template)
4. Wait for CI checks to pass (or note any infra-only checks failing — these are pre-existing)
5. gh pr merge --squash --delete-branch
6. Verify: git fetch origin && git branch -r | grep feature/WF03-GH533-20260807 OR echo deleted
7. Return to main: git checkout main && git pull --ff-only origin main
8. Verify clean state: git status (clean), git branch --show-current → main

Capture PR number and merge commit SHA in result.
acceptance_criteria: Local repo on main with clean working tree
PR number and merge SHA recorded in handoff result

result.summary: Git-merge completed successfully. Rebased feature/WF03-GH533-20260807 onto origin/main (no conflicts), pushed, opened PR #539, squash-merged, deleted feature branch both locally and remotely, and returned local repo to main with clean working tree.
